breadcrumb.name: Everything You Need to Know About the Golden Investor Visa in Abu Dhabi

contentHtml:
Abu Dhabi Golden Investor visa works as a key to having a business in UAE having its own benefits.

We brought this article just for you to share everything about the Abu Dhabi Investor Visa and its benefits. It has useful information about the types of Investor Visa in Dubai and their requirements. Our article goes over these points:

1. Introduction to Golden Investor Visa

2. Types of Golden Investors

3. Application Platform

4. Frequently asked questions

5. Why Connect Group?

 

 

What is the Golden Investor Visa in Abu Dhabi?

Investors need specific visas for investment activities. With this UAE visa, you can:

 

    • invest in an existing or new business in any of Abu Dhabi’s jurisdictions
    • get certain benefits
    • have the possibility of investing in Abu Dhabi mainland or free zones
    • sponsor your family members

 

 

Types of Golden Investors in Abu Dhabi

Depending on your needs and budget, foreign investors can apply for any of these two investor visas:

 

    • A 5-year visa
    • A 10-year visa

 

 

Abu Dhabi 10-year Golden Investor Visa

This particular visa is for:-

 

    • people who invest in an existing business
    • individuals establishing their own business in free zones of Abu Dhabi

 

By becoming one of the following you become eligible for it:

 

    • deposit at least AED 2 million in an investment fund
    • deposit AED 2 million in a bank account in Abu Dhabi
    • opt for setting up a company worth no less than AED 2 million in Abu Dhabi
    • establish a partnership:
    • with an existing business
    • a new company
    • provide a financial contribution of at least AED 2 million
    • own a company
    • become a partner in an existing company that pays federal government taxes of at least AED 250,000 per year

 

 

Additional requirements for Abu Dhabi 10-year Golden Investor Visa

There are some additional requirements:

 

    • submit your official bank statements for the last 6 months
    • submit a trade license
    • a tax clearance certificate

 

 

Abu Dhabi 5-year Golden Investor Visa for Real Estate Investors

Real estate investors qualify for this type of visa by:

 

    • investing with a minimum of AED 2 million in:-
    • real estate
    • mortgaged properties
    • maintaining investment for 2 years after the visa issuance

 

 

Additional Requirements for Abu Dhabi 5-year Golden Investor Visa for Real Estate Investors

For it, you:

 

    • Provide proof of real estate investment worth AED 2 million for a single investment profile.
    • Give proof of mortgage status.

 

 

Documents for Golden Investor Visa application

To apply for the visas, you are to submit the following documents:

 

    • A copy of your valid passport
    • Proof of investment
    • A copy of your Emirates ID
    • Colored photographs
    • A copy of your UAE residence visa
    • A valid health insurance policy
    • Tax settlement
    • Proof of deposit or investment amount
    • Proof of establishing a partnership or a new company
    • And the Company Valuation Certificate or Business Valuation Certification

 

For real estate investors, there are some additional things to be submitted:

 

    • A real estate unit value certificate.
    • Proof of property purchase.
    • A copy of the certificate issued by the pertinent real estate entity.
    • A copy of the purchase agreement
    • A search certificate or its equivalent certificate issued by the pertinent authorities.

 

 

Modes to apply for Golden Investor Visa in Abu Dhabi?

 

    1. You choose a modality to start the application process. It has two options:
    2. apply online through TAMM’s website
    3. applying by visiting any of the registered typing centers

 

Both options have different details you need to know about, like:

 

    1. duration
    2. costs
    3. procedures

 

 

Through TAMM’s website

The first option is to complete the application process through TAMM’s official website. For this, you need to follow several steps:

 

    1. visit this website
    2. scroll down to find the “Visa and Emirates ID” option
    3. click it
    4. select the “Request for Golden Visa Nomination” option
    5. wait to be redirected to a new page
    6. click on the “Start” icon
    7. sign in with the UAE Pass

 

start the application process by submitting documents.

 

Duration

It usually takes around 7 days to get a response from the authorities.

 

Through a registered typing center in Abu Dhabi

You can opt for this second option if you do not want to complete the process through TAMM’s website. Visit any of the registered typing centers and apply for your desired visa.

 

Cost

When applying for a Golden Investor Visa in Abu Dhabi, you pay several fees. The total cost varies depending on.

When applying for a visa through a typing center, you pay these fees:

 

    1. A request fee
    2. Issue fee
    3. E-services fee
    4. ICA fee

 

 

Frequently asked questions: Golden Investor Visa

 

How can an applicant get a Golden Investor Visa in Abu Dhabi?

The two options for a person are:

 

    • Invest AED 2 million in a public sector company
    • Apply for a 5-year long-term visa

 

 

Can Golden Investor Visa holders in Abu Dhabi sponsor their dependents?

The Golden Investor visa holders in Abu Dhabi can sponsor their:-

 

    • spouse
    • parents
    • children

 

 

Can I apply for a Business Golden Visa in the UAE?

A Business Golden Visa is for:

 

    • investors
    • entrepreneurs
    • special talents

 

The application process varies depending on the applicant’s goals.

 

Does Dubai offer an Investor Visa?

Dubai offers an investor visa as well but the benefits vary.
